Select the mission-parity graphics family, clear requests, spawn the three standard actors and synchronize rendering with NMI and sprite zero. The entry at $8007 preserves the message timer. Marked cells may be suppressed by flight mode. A timed message overrides strip data; its classified continuation finishes the fourteen-cell loop and hides the heading marker.

phase1.label: ScreenDescriptorRecords

regions.summary: Twelve twenty-two-byte screen descriptors. Offsets 0/1 select display CHR and pattern mode, offset 2 selects source CHR, offsets 3/4 hold the source PPU address, and offsets 6..21 hold sixteen background colors. Destination is fixed at PPU $2000; offset 5 is not read by this consumer. LoadScreenDescriptor copies a 1024-byte screen before applying palette/rendering state.

phase1.evidence: analysis/round-001/discovery-*.json: validated reset/NMI/IRQ vectors and saved actual opcode fetch roots, explicit effective PRG banks [0,1,2,3]; bounded successor/control flow, stops at mapper uncertainty and indirect targets. Observed only for preserved fetched roots.

regions.summary: Read a text pointer from CHR bank 15, copy 250 bytes to CPU page $07, select display CHR and interpret the stream. Initial two bytes specify a PPU destination; $fe changes destination relatively and $ff ends. Printable bytes map letters/digits/punctuation to tiles plus a caller bias. Optional typewriter mode plays sound and delays six frames per glyph. Text scratch overlaps OAM staging, so callers control rendering/mode.

Optional typewriter mode plays sound and delays six frames per glyph. Text scratch overlaps OAM staging, so callers control rendering/mode.

units.summary: Dispatch by the result byte through the three-entry result-handler table. This is distinct from the even-index auxiliary-state table.

units.name: UpdateActiveServiceSprite
units.summary: Apply input-controlled acceleration and movement, select the animation pose and draw the active service sprite.

units.name: FinishSuccessfulServiceMotion
units.summary: Count down the success delay, then set the completion high bit. Continue drawing the main sprite and advancing its animation.

units.name: FinishFailedServiceAnimation
units.summary: Advance failure frames at five-tick intervals until the remaining count reaches zero, then set the completion high bit.

units.name: DrawServiceResultAnimation
units.summary: Draw the main service sprite after advancing its result animation state.

units.name: IntegrateServiceMotion
units.summary: Scale horizontal velocity and split vertical acceleration, preserving sign flags for the axis helpers, then update both coordinates.

units.name: ReadServiceMovementInput
units.summary: Save old X; nonzero service states synthesize an Up input, while arrival polls the controller. Dispatch exact controller values through the control callback table.

units.name: DispatchServiceMovementInput
units.summary: Select the exact-input callback table and tail-dispatch its matching acceleration handler.

units.name: ScaleServiceSignedMagnitude
units.summary: Preserve processor flags, complement negative input, divide magnitude by eight and restore flags. Axis helpers consume the original sign; this is one's-complement magnitude, not an absolute-value correction.

units.name: MoveServiceHorizontal
units.summary: Apply scaled magnitude left or right according to the preserved sign and clamp at 0 or $c0 when already at a boundary.

units.name: MoveServiceVertical
units.summary: Apply the same signed motion vertically, using $10 and $b8 as boundary clamps.

units.name: DampServiceHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: On even frames move nonzero horizontal velocity one step toward zero.

units.name: AccelerateServiceLeft
units.summary: Decrease horizontal velocity down to signed -11.

units.name: AccelerateServiceRight
units.summary: Increase horizontal velocity up to nine.

units.name: AccelerateServiceUp
units.summary: Damp horizontal velocity and subtract $00f0 from vertical velocity down to the negative threshold.

units.name: SubtractServiceVerticalAcceleration
units.summary: Apply the upward vertical acceleration portion without repeating horizontal damping.

units.name: AccelerateServiceDown
units.summary: Damp horizontal velocity and add $00f0 up to the positive threshold.

units.name: AddServiceVerticalAcceleration
units.summary: Apply the downward vertical acceleration portion without repeating horizontal damping.

units.name: AccelerateServiceUpLeft
units.summary: Combine the left and up acceleration steps.

units.name: AccelerateServiceDownLeft
units.summary: Combine the left and down acceleration steps.

units.name: AccelerateServiceUpRight
units.summary: Combine the right and up acceleration steps.

units.name: AccelerateServiceDownRight
units.summary: Combine the right and down acceleration steps.

units.name: SelectServiceSpritePose
units.summary: Choose direction relative to the saved X and service orientation, add the low-altitude pose bit and toggle its animation phase on a small countdown.

units.name: ServicePoseFromHorizontalChange
units.summary: Return direction code four/eight from old versus new X, reversing interpretation for the alternate service selector; return zero when unchanged.

units.name: DrawMainServiceSprite
units.summary: Transform main position and emit the current frame, attributes and service-orientation flags.

units.name: AdvanceServiceSpriteAnimation
units.summary: Read five-byte duration/frame/dX/dY/flags records, looping at $ff. Accumulate relative position once per record and draw the current animation every frame.

units.name: TestServiceLandingAndCollision
units.summary: At the lower boundary distinguish aligned low-speed landing from failure. Success sets result one and selects the next animation; failure starts result two with a three-frame animation. Otherwise test rectangle and bitmap collisions against auxiliary/background geometry.

units.name: BeginFailedServiceResult
units.summary: Set the failure delay/frame, move Y down eight, select attribute one and result two. This entry may be reached after explicitly unwinding one nested return.

units.name: ServiceAxisOverlapsAuxiliary
units.summary: Return one when the auxiliary coordinate lies inside the main coordinate's forty-unit interval, otherwise zero.

units.name: TestServiceSpriteBitmapCollision
units.summary: Resolve the current frame bitmap and test two auxiliary points; combine their hits in work8.

units.name: TestServiceBitmapPoint
units.summary: Transform a point into a coarse frame-cell index and reject outside the two-row bound or transparent $ff cell. Return one for a solid cell and zero otherwise.

units.name: TestThreeServiceCollisionSegments
units.summary: Check three consecutive three-byte collision segments, with each successful test able to enter the common failure path.

units.name: TestServiceCollisionSegment
units.summary: Compare Y with its vertical threshold and X with the half-open left/right interval. A hit pops one return address and transfers directly to failure, skipping the three-segment caller's remainder.

units.name: UploadServicePaletteRequest
units.summary: Inspect the service palette request bits, upload the selected sixteen colors and clear the high request bits. The two branches currently use the same source pointer and destination.

units.name: ClearServicePaletteRequestBits
units.summary: Retain only the low six service palette bits after uploading the requested colors.

units.name: ScaleServiceDisplayCoordinate
units.summary: Convert A to floor(A/2)+$40 in the display coordinate domain.

units.name: AlternateSceneOamAllocation
units.summary: Alternate ascending and descending sprite allocation and reset the corresponding hidden OAM tail. The descending limit is the literal byte $56, not a negative decimal value.

regions.summary: Fill thirty rows of thirty-two tiles using A, then sixty-four attribute bytes using work0. X/Y supply the PPU address low/high bytes. Emit bytes below $80 after subtracting $2f. High-bit commands skip forward in the PPU destination; $ff terminates. Streams must terminate within the byte-indexed page. Advance the byte cursor after a literal or skip command and continue interpreting the tile string. Emit literal tiles; $fe advances the destination by one nametable row and $ff ends the stream. Reset the PPU address at completion. Advance the literal-stream cursor after drawing or moving to the next row. Subtract $2f from A and draw one tile at X/Y PPU destination. Rotate eight bits through carry and emit tile $fd or $fe for each bit. Preserve the original stack balancing and incoming-carry behavior. Split A into high and low nibbles, index the hexadecimal character table and draw two biased tiles. Scan three-byte value/pointer records until a value equals controller_one (through indexed zero page) or $ff ends the table; tail-dispatch the matching handler. Read the next value/pointer triple and compare its key with the requested controller byte.
